description: This file defines the internal representation of a URI within the HTML Purifier library, including properties for URI components, validation methods, scheme retrieval, and serialization to string.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URI
classes.description: Represents a URI with methods for validation, scheme retrieval, and string conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a URI object, normalizing scheme and port.

methods.name: getSchemeObj
methods.description: Retrieves the scheme object used to validate the URI based on its scheme component.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation and normalization on URI components, encoding parts as needed.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the URI object back into a URI string.
